title: AVOIDDS: Aircraft Vision-based Intruder Detection Dataset and Simulator
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical benchmark for vision-based aircraft detection and collision avoidance. While it deals with 'safety-critical' applications, its evaluation metrics (precision, recall, mAP, NMAC frequency) are quantitative performance measures for the system, not a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as defined.
